housing.summary: Average 1-bedroom apartment in Mississauga city centre is approximately CAD 2,396/month per Numbeo (Aug 2026). Ontario landlords typically require first and last month's rent as deposit. Kijiji.ca and rentals.ca are primary rental portals.

banking.summary: Major Canadian banks serve Mississauga. Newcomers need passport, immigration document, proof of Ontario address, and SIN if available. RBC and TD Bank both offer newcomer packages. Numbeo reports an average monthly transit pass of CAD 141 in Mississauga.
required_docs: Immigration document (work permit, study permit, or PR card)

schools.summary: Mississauga is served by Peel District School Board (public) and Dufferin-Peel Catholic District School Board. International Baccalaureate (IB) and French Immersion programs are available. Peel DSB has a dedicated newcomer welcome centre program.
curricula: International Baccalaureate (IB) at select secondary schools

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers on work or study permits must notify IRCC of address changes via the IRCC portal. Permanent residents update SIN address with Service Canada. Ontario drivers must exchange a foreign licence within 60 days of becoming an Ontario resident.
legal_admin.registration_step: Update address with IRCC at ircc.canada.ca if on work/study permit; permanent residents update SIN address at Service Canada.

tax_finance.summary: A Social Insurance Number (SIN) is Canada's tax identification number, issued by Service Canada. Required for work, tax filing, and government benefits. Apply at a Service Canada office or online.

transport.summary: MiWay (Mississauga Transit) operates the city bus network; PRESTO card is used. Adult monthly PRESTO pass is CAD 145. Newcomers must exchange foreign driving licences within 60 days in Ontario (via ServiceOntario/MTO). Ontario OHIP health card has no waiting period as of recent policy — coverage begins immediately upon eligibility determination.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Foreign licence holders must exchange to an Ontario licence within 60 days of becoming an Ontario resident. Apply at a ServiceOntario centre (ontario.ca/page/serviceontario-locations).
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply for OHIP (Ontario Health Insurance Plan) at a ServiceOntario location. There is no longer a waiting period — coverage begins immediately upon approval. Bring immigration documents, proof of Ontario residency, and proof of identity.
